_about: Alexander Bain (1818-1903), Scottish philosopher and psychologist: Moral Science, a compendium of ethics (1869) and Practical Essays (1884), clean Gutenberg texts, and The Emotions and the Will, 3rd ed. (London: Longmans, Green, 1875; raw OCR of a Google scan). Not R. Nisbet Bain the translator (bain shelf). Added in round am: The Senses and the Intellect, third edition (New York: D. Appleton, 1879). Added in round am: Mental and Moral Science: a compendium of psychology and ethics, both parts bound together (London: Longmans, Green, 1872); its ethics part overlaps the separately issued Moral Science above. US public domain. No uids minted.
